title_vi: Bảy thuật ngữ của thiết kế hướng miền, và cái giá của một khối dữ liệu quá lớn

claims.evidence: Microsoft's tactical DDD page read from a local clone; entity, value object and optimistic-version behaviour of small Python 3.13.16 programs run on 2026-10-19 (three runs per load). The Evans book was unreachable, so the definitions rest on the source and the Microsoft page.

Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: Microsoft: entity has persistent identity and should hold behaviour; value object has no identity, is immutable and interchangeable by value; aggregate is a consistency boundary with one root, designed small, other aggregates referenced by identity only, eventual consistency between aggregates via domain events; domain service is stateless business logic spanning entities, application service orchestrates use cases with no business logic; a domain event is a domain-significant change (a delivery was cancelled, not a row inserted); factories, repositories and modules are named but not covered.
claims.verified_by: Read from a local clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Source lists seven terms in three groups: Entity, Value Object, Aggregate (composition); Repository, Factory (life cycle); Domain Service, Domain Event (behaviour); Aggregate described as the unit of storage.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Python 3.13.16: frozen dataclass values equal by value, assignment raises FrozenInstanceError, replace gives a new instance; entities with the same id compare equal with different attributes; cancel refused after pick_up and an event recorded.
claims.verified_by: Program run by the author on 2026-10-19.

claims.claim_vi: Optimistic versioned store, 8 threads, 2,400 updates: one shared aggregate gave 44-67 conflicts with light work, 1,279-1,586 with 10x work, 8,618-8,778 with 100x work (4,057-4,407 ms); one aggregate per delivery gave 0 conflicts (895-981 ms at 100x); no update lost in any run.
claims.verified_by: Program run by the author on 2026-10-19, three runs per load; absolute numbers belong to the test machine.

design_notes_vi: Ba khung: bảy thuật ngữ chia nhóm, thử trong mã, đo xung đột theo cỡ khối.
source_deviations: The source is a list of seven terms with a picture; the lesson adds the Microsoft reading of aggregate as consistency boundary, three code tests and a contention measurement.
Repository and Factory are explained from the source only; no test.
